name: obsidian-violet
description: Dark-first violet-on-obsidian system for NouGen Shards. Dense, atmospheric, glow-based rather than shadow-based.

provenance.observed: Measured from shipped application CSS and component class usage.
provenance.inferred: Derived from class-usage frequency; corroborated where a literal constant in the source lands on a proposed step.
provenance.invented: Authored here. The source was silent: tracking, leading, elevation tier 1, the focus ring, the compliant brand fill, the chart ramp, and the entire light theme.

openWork: Light-mode chart ramp: all eight dark series fall between 1.4:1 and 3.1:1 on the light ground and fail. Must be computed independently, not lightened.
Source application still forces a single color scheme; the light tokens have nowhere to land until its theme block is split.
